name: An NPC talked to by one player still fights another (run with npc-talk-fight-test2.json on the other VM at the same time): once test2 says it's ready, test spawns a monk beside it, test2 talks to the monk and leaves the chat open, and test shoots the monk from 4 tiles; the monk walks over and hits back. Exploit review round 10, NPC-1

steps.comment: a new account's stats, nothing worn or carried; ::reset at the end puts the account back
live's rate, so no level-up box opens mid-fight; ::xprate restore at the end goes back
test2's public chat line, said once it stands on 3227, 3218
an Edgeville monk (Talk-to and Attack), standing still, on our tile
4 tiles west of the monk: in the shortbow's range, out of the monk's reach
test2 talks to the monk as soon as it sees it, a tick or two after the spawn
in range and in sight, so no walk
the first arrow lands (a hit or a miss)
a hitsplat on us (a hit or a miss): the monk walked the 3 tiles over and fought back, though test2's chat with it is still open. Before the fix it stood still
